ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch localized on the distal left lobe. Fragmented, mottled white/gray pixel clusters on the distal right lobe. Continuous thin high-intensity border along the superior trailing edge. Central and proximal regions are predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 60 degrees; depth of the notch is roughly 1/5th the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; peaks and valleys occur with variable amplitudes (approx. 5-15 pixels), most pronounced on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the notch to the outer tips, which terminate in sharp, upward-pointing angles.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-intensity circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) visible on the distal right lobe and within the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly parallel diagonal high-contrast white linear marks on the mid-left lobe; multiple shorter, thinner vertical/diagonal linear disruptions scattered across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake-mark scars (linear abrasions) on both lobes; highly irregular and jagged trailing edge indicative of physical wear or past mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right lobes; the right lobe tip exhibits a more fragmented 'torn' pixel profile compared to the left.
